How to play Story Chain

Build the most chaotic story together Players take turns adding one sentence to a shared story. Nobody knows where it goes — and that's the whole point. The wilder the twist, the better.

3–10 players~10 minChaotic & CreativeWord games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Choose who goes first.
  2. That person says one sentence to start a story — any story.
  3. Going clockwise, each player adds exactly one sentence that continues from the last.
  4. No skipping, no correcting. Whatever gets said stays.
  5. Keep going until the story reaches a natural (or hilarious) end.

Example round

  • "One day, Alex found a mysterious briefcase in the subway."
  • "Inside was nothing but 400 plastic spoons and a note that said 'you're next.'"
  • "Alex immediately knew this was about the great spoon heist of 2019."
  • "So he called his uncle — a retired competitive spoon collector."

Tips

  • Force unexpected twists — teleport characters, kill off heroes, introduce aliens. The weirder, the better.
  • If someone tries to 'fix' a bad sentence, they owe the group a penalty.
